milestone.title: Floating milestone picker: centered multi-select overlay with narrow-terminal modal fallback and a Starting… state on Start

intent.outcome: Choosing milestones for an autopilot run happens in a floating, centered overlay with checkboxes, filters, and search (full-screen modal on narrow terminals), and the Start button visibly acknowledges activation until the run goes live.

problem.description: After M241 the setup form's Milestones section shows chips from app.autopilot.picker (crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot.rs::Picker { candidates, selected: Vec<String>, cursor }) but there is no way to browse and multi-select across the plan: the picker only lists drivable candidates inline, with no filtering or search. The audit asked for a floating overlay (not full-screen) with checkbox multi-select, a dimmed backdrop, filters, and search, collapsing to a full-screen modal on narrow terminals. Separately, pressing Start gives no feedback during the ~250-500ms before mp autopilot status reports the live run and M241's takeover appears.

in_scope: Picker state in a new crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot_picker.rs: rows from the mp list milestones data raul already loads (all milestones), each flagged drivable via mp_model::is_watch_drivable_lifecycle; draft selection (Vec<String> ids) seeded from app.autopilot.picker.selected on open; filter; search query; focus; dismiss-armed flag.

Renderer in a new crates/raul/src/tui/render/autopilot_picker.rs: overlay centered over the middle 2/3 of the frame (width and height); everything behind it rendered with the palette dim style (terminal backdrop — no alpha).
Opened from M241's [+ select] chip (click, or Enter when the Milestones section has focus).

Checkbox multi-select: space or x toggles the focused row; clicking a checkbox toggles without moving focus; clicking a row focuses it. Non-drivable rows render their lifecycle badge and cannot be selected.
Filter chips (mutually exclusive): all / drivable / in-progress / complete. Selection is kept across filter and search changes.
Search: / focuses the search box; matches id prefix or case-insensitive title substring; 'No milestones match the filter' empty state disables Confirm.
Summary line: '<n> selected · <topology> · harness: uniform <name> | mixed', live.

Confirm writes the draft into app.autopilot.picker.selected (in memory, per-run — nothing persisted) and closes; with 0 selected, the first Confirm shows 'no milestones selected — Start will be disabled' and a second Confirm closes. Cancel / Esc closes without changes.
Outside click: the first arms dismissal and shows 'click again to close'; the second closes (same as Cancel).
Modal key handling while open (overrides global/lane keys, including g, /, 1-4): j/k move, gg/G top/bottom, space/x toggle, 1-4 select filter chip, / search, Enter confirm, Esc cancel.
Narrow fallback: frame width < 100 cols renders the same state full-screen through the same renderer entry point.

Start feedback: after Start is activated, the Start button renders 'Starting…' in the accent style until mp autopilot status reports a live run (M241 takeover) or the start command returns an error (button returns to normal and the error shows in the status line).
Help overlay: add the picker's modal keys to the Autopilot section (M241).
out_of_scope: Persisting the selection across runs or raul restarts.
Run-time estimates in the summary line.
Changing M241's geometry, sidebar, or takeover.

acceptance_criteria.description: The picker opens as an overlay centered over the middle 2/3 of the frame, with everything behind it drawn in the palette dim style.
space or x toggles the focused row; clicking a checkbox toggles without moving focus; clicking a row focuses it.
Selection is kept across filter and search changes.
Four mutually exclusive filter chips (all / drivable / in-progress / complete) update the list; non-drivable rows show their lifecycle badge and cannot be selected.
/ focuses search; matches id prefix or case-insensitive title substring; no matches shows the empty state and disables Confirm.
The summary line '<n> selected · <topology> · harness: uniform <name> | mixed' updates live; with 0 selected the first Confirm warns and the second closes.
Confirm writes the draft into app.autopilot.picker.selected and closes; Cancel / Esc closes without changes; nothing is persisted to disk.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast --test autopilot_picker -E 'test(/confirm|cancel/)' && ! rg -q 'autopilot-state\.json' crates/raul/src

acceptance_criteria.description: Below 100 columns the same picker state renders full-screen through the same renderer entry point.
After Start is activated the button shows 'Starting…' until mp autopilot status reports a live run or the start command errors (then it resets and the error is shown).

The first outside click arms dismissal with a 'click again to close' hint and the second closes; while open, picker keys (j/k, gg/G, space/x, 1-4, /, Enter, Esc) override global and lane bindings and are listed in the help overlay.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast --test autopilot_picker -E 'test(/outside_click|modal_keys/)' && cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/help_overlay_autopilot/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: raul tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint
